title: Scipio defeats Hannibal at Zama
summary: Scipio Africanus defeated Hannibal near Zama in North Africa, ending the Second Punic War in Rome's favour.
reason: Scipio had carried the war to Africa, forcing Carthage to recall Hannibal from Italy to defend the city.
significance: Carthage lost its empire and fleet, and Rome became the leading power of the western Mediterranean.
